thread:
alex: quick heads-up — profiling on Mixtral and Qwen workloads shows a weird latency tail after recent kernel selector change

maria: saw that too, stack?

alex: root: tokenizer falling back to byte-path for ~8% of requests (special tokens in legacy chat templates). fallback increases token count by 30%-ish which pushes sequence length into a different kernel path. micro numbers: median 45ms -> 62ms, p95 220ms -> 410ms for those flows.

ken: ouch. which models? Llama, Mixtral, Qwen?

alex: mostly Mixtral-7B and Qwen-7B-cls in customers using old chat templates (we didn't normalize BOS/EOS placement). Also some Llama-2 endpoints where RoPE scaling mismatch caused a KV reshape fallback.

maria: can you paste the flaky sample prompts?

alex: sure:
```
USER: <system>Welcome</system> Hello!
-> tokenization: [<system>, Welcome, </system>, Hello, !] -> byte-fallback for </system> on some codepoints -> tokenized length +12 tokens
```

ken: so tokenizer variability causes kernel selector to pick the long-seq matmul kernel (different tiling) which we don't JIT-bundle for that model/hw combo yet. Fallback to generic kernel.

infra-bot: deploy 1779554700: rolling kernel-selector tweak reverted for Mixtral groups due to perf regression (author: deploy-bot) :warning:

maria: nice. two followups: 1) can we canonicalize chat templates at ingress (strip legacy system tags / force single BOS/EOS)? 2) add a quick path in kernel selector for +10 tokens over median to avoid full generic fallback.

ken: agree. also need to address RoPE scaling bug — when model quant/profile expects rope_scale=1.0 but customer inference config uses 1.001 (hist mismatch from model import), KV shape check fails and we do a reshape path that reorders tensors -> expensive. I profiled: KV reshape + copy is ~12ms per layer * 32 layers = ~384ms worst-case. That's the p99 killer for Llama-variants.

alex: suggested short-term mitigations:
- canonicalize templates at edge (strip system tags, normalize whitespace, ensure explicit BOS/EOS)
- add a tokenizer metric to logs for fallback-rate (%)
- add a 'len-safety' heuristic in kernel selector: if token_len <= model_median + delta, keep fast kernel but cap batch size to avoid memory blowup

sasha: for RoPE: we can add a tolerant kv-shape-accept with a cheap rotary scaling remap that avoids a full copy if scale delta < 0.01. cheaper ops: elementwise mul on KV cache vs full reorder. will prototype.

maria: good. can we also gate rollout by customer tier? don't want to impact enterprise SLAs.

ken: deployment plan:
- patch edge canonicalizer -> small lambda-like box, rollout to 10% -> monitor token-fallback metric
- add kernel-selector len-safety toggle behind feature flag -> canary on Mixtral pool only
- RoPE tolerant path -> bench on GPU types (A10/A100) before enabling

alex: I'll attach the perf snippets to the ticket (p95/p99 profiles + sample prompts). for transparency: quick numbers after reverting kernel selector: p95 for affected flows back to ~230ms, p99 ~460ms (still slightly higher than original due to cold KV warmups).

maria: nice work. small TODOs: alex add sample prompts + histogram, ken add feature-flag PR, sasha prototype ropemap. I'll schedule a 30m sync if we need cross-team pairing. :thumbsup:

ken: logging note: include a short tag in request metadata: \"tokenizer_path\": \"byte\"|\"standard\" so we can filter in tracing/console.

alex: added that to the list. thanks all.

infra-bot: incident auto-note: created perf-regression-177955 for tracking — assigned to eng-runtime.
